data.fund_type: Mid Cap Fund - An open ended equity scheme predominantly investing in mid cap stocks.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to achieve long term capital appreciation and generate income by investing predominantly in equity and equity related securities of mid cap companies. However, there is no assurance that the Investment Objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity & Equity related instruments of mid cap companies# - 65% - 100% of net assets, Equity and Equity related instruments of companies other than Mid Cap companies# - 0% - 35% of net assets, Debt and Money Market instruments - 0%-35% of net assets, Units issued by InvITs - 0% - 10% of net assets. (#In accordance with SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/IMD/DF3/CIR/P/2017/114 dated October 6, 2017, as amended from time to time, Large Cap, Mid Cap and Small Cap are defined as follows: Large Cap: 1st-100th company in terms of full market capitalization, Mid Cap: 101st - 250th company in terms of full market capitalization, Small Cap: 251st company onwards in terms of full market capitalization.) Please refer the Scheme Information Document for more details.
data.fund_managers: FM 1 - Mr. Gaurav Chopra, FM 2 - Mr. Pratik Dharmshi
data.exit_load: 1% if units are redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 15 days from the date of allotment. Nil thereafter.
